responses.text: You've done a good turn for the NCR and now we'd like to do one for you - here's an NCR emergency two-way radio - you call and we'll come running.
You're not alone out here - the NCR has your back. Stay safe and good hunting.
{Radio transmission} Coordinates for supply cache in your region being sent... now.
{Radio transmission} NCR Ranger support en route to your location.
{Radio transmission} There is no NCR support in your area - suggest a tactical retreat.
{Radio transmission} Sorry, sir, that's all the support I can spare today.
{Radio transmission} Support request received - deploying Troopers to your area. Hold tight, help is on the way.
{Radio transmission} Received - find some cover, NCR support is on the way.
